description: Land Title Settlement Department - Periyakulama, Puttalam D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 410115
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for various parcels in Puttalam District. It contains detailed schedules listing land parcels, their extents, and registered owners, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
